title: Sum of selected matrix columns
statement: Let $H$ be an $m$-by-$n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The sum of the columns of $H$ indexed by $S$ is the vector in $\mathbb F_2^m$ whose $r$th coordinate is $\sum_{j\in S}H_{rj}$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of column indices in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
